bug_semantics: DownloadFileRequestHandler derives fileName from the /file/* path, then accepts the request's version parameter and passes it unchanged to BaseUtils.replaceFileNameAndExtension. That helper returns FilenameUtils.getFullPath(fileName) + version, and FileUtils.readFile/createFile ultimately opens new File(APP_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_PATH, fileName) without canonical containment checking. On the unauthenticated /file/static/noauth/** route, a request to /file/static/noauth with a version such as ../../... therefore replaces the benign basename with a traversal path and reads a server file outside the download folder.
flaw_origin: Commit b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46 first added both the unsafe replaceFileNameAndExtension helper and the three handler lines that read the untrusted version parameter and replace fileName without validation. Its direct parent 51dd90c21ec7e7b289fde206208106cf80b835f8 has neither the version read nor replacement. Commit 87b7b9e81d8ebdf52b0480cfcad78c5817603883 later exposed /downloadFile/static/noauth/** without authentication, and 256ae9dcb19d8762b1cb43f2d1e688d46592581c renamed that public endpoint to the advisory's /file/static/noauth/**; these later exposure/rename commits did not write the unsafe version-to-path logic and are not the BIC.
ai_marker: absent: `git cat-file commit b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46` shows author and committer AlexKirkouski <alex.kirkouski@gmail.com>, one parent, and only the subject `Resources / web client refactoring`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI trailer and no bot identity.
evidence: First-party issue https://github.com/lsfusion/platform/issues/1543 identifies affected versions <= 6.1, DownloadFileRequestHandler, the unauthenticated /file/static/noauth endpoint, and traversal through version. In the validated clone, `git log --all -S'request.getParameter("version")' -- web-client/src/main/java/lsfusion/http/controller/file/DownloadFileRequestHandler.java` returns only b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46 as the first addition; `git log -L 44,46:web-client/src/main/java/lsfusion/http/controller/file/DownloadFileRequestHandler.java 9dc9a7889f8120d6bd6802c09b374639642cbcb9^` resolves the three vulnerable lines to the same commit. `git show b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46 --` shows the handler adding the unchecked version replacement and api/src/main/java/lsfusion/base/BaseUtils.java adding `return FilenameUtils.getFullPath(filePath) + toName`; `git show b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46^:web-client/src/main/java/lsfusion/http/controller/file/DownloadFileRequestHandler.java` directly verifies the parent lacks all version handling. `git show 6.1:web-client/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/security-config.xml` shows `/file/static/noauth/**` with security=none, while `git show 6.1:web-client/src/main/java/lsfusion/http/controller/file/DownloadFileRequestHandler.java` still shows the unchecked replacement before FileUtils.readFile. `git show 9dc9a7889f8120d6bd6802c09b374639642cbcb9` shows the direct closing fix `Fixed unauthorized arbitrary file read (closes #1543)`: it rejects any version containing `..` with HTTP 400 before replacement. Release-line commit d828168524d47f78426b68a58ef7905eb2d4dca0 has the identical patch and explicitly says it was cherry-picked from 9dc9a7889f8120d6bd6802c09b374639642cbcb9. `git tag --contains b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46` lists 5.0-beta0, 5.0, 5.1, the 6.0 prereleases, 6.0, 6.1, and 6.2; `git describe --tags --abbrev=0 b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46^` yields 4.1, establishing introduction after 4.1 and before 5.0-beta0. `git tag --contains 9dc9a7889f8120d6bd6802c09b374639642cbcb9` yields no tag, whereas `git tag --contains d828168524d47f78426b68a58ef7905eb2d4dca0` yields 6.2; `git show 6.2:web-client/src/main/java/lsfusion/http/controller/file/DownloadFileRequestHandler.java` contains the rejection, establishing 6.1 vulnerable and 6.2 fixed. Finally, `git cat-file commit b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46` reproduces the marker-absence claim.
reasoning: The causal flaw is not merely the later public route: it is the first conversion of attacker-controlled version text into the filesystem-relative name without validation. Both pickaxe and line-history converge on b34987f7b37b5fd6a03b9dd9092bd18efc936d46, and direct inspection of its parent proves absence. The 2023 no-auth mapping made the already-existing traversal remotely reachable without credentials, and the 2024 rename produced the advisory's exact URL. The original fix 9dc9a7889f8120d6bd6802c09b374639642cbcb9 closes the root path injection before the sink; its d828168524d47f78426b68a58ef7905eb2d4dca0 cherry-pick is the fix included in release 6.2. The BIC is a normal one-parent commit rather than a move, merge, revert, or reconstructable squash, so no decomposition is warranted. Because the BIC commit object contains only human author/committer identities and no AI attribution marker, the BIC-only decision is NOT_AI.
